title.zh: 10月4日23:07 UTC核对：伤亡无新公报
title.en: 4 Oct 23:07 UTC check: no newer official toll
title.ne: 4 Oct 23:07 UTC: naya official toll chaina
title.hi: 4 Oct 23:07 UTC: naya official toll nahi

body.zh: 本轮核新华社、gov.cn与@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus：中方仍为9月5日18时口43死、519失联、2人获救。epardafas引述周日5时：博特科西洪水已寻获1456具遗体，仍寻4718名失踪者；警力7975人，安置点1240人。获救数仍用NDRRMA 9月26日13795。堰塞湖仍为新华社9月5日已排空。无新UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS。美使馆道路告示仍为9月3日。
body.en: Recheck of Xinhua, gov.cn and @XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN remains 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. epardafas cites Sunday 05:00: 1456 bodies recovered, search continues for 4718 missing; 7975 police, 1240 in holding centres. Rescued still NDRRMA 26 Sep figure 13795. Barrier lake remains Xinhua 5 Sep drained. No new UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS. US Embassy road notice remains 3 Sep.
body.ne: Xinhua/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN 5 Sep 18:00 43/519/2. epardafas aaitabar 05:00: 1456 sharir, 4718 harayeka; police 7975, kendra 1240. Uddar NDRRMA 26 Sep 13795. Tal Xinhua 5 Sep khali. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS chaina. US Embassy notice 3 Sep.
body.hi: Xinhua/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN 5 Sep 18:00 43/519/2. epardafas ravivar 05:00: 1456 sharir, 4718 lapata; police 7975, kendra 1240. Uddhar NDRRMA 26 Sep 13795. Jheel Xinhua 5 Sep khali. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS nahi. US Embassy notice 3 Sep.

title.zh: 尼泊尔警方10月4日5时：1456死、4718失踪

body.zh: epardafas引述：截至周日5时已寻获1456具遗体（拉苏瓦236、努瓦科特204、达迪73、廊尔喀80、坦湖华38、契特旺369、纳瓦尔帕拉西东232、西222，加德满都治疗死亡2），仍寻4718名失踪者。未更新获救数。
body.en: epardafas: as of Sunday 05:00, 1456 bodies recovered (Rasuwa 236, Nuwakot 204, Dhading 73, Gorkha 80, Tanahun 38, Chitwan 369, Nawalparasi East 232, West 222, plus 2 who died under treatment in Kathmandu); search continues for 4718 missing. Rescued not updated.
body.ne: epardafas: aaitabar 05:00, 1456 sharir (Rasuwa 236), 4718 harayeka khoj jari. Uddar update chaina.
body.hi: epardafas: ravivar 05:00, 1456 sharir (Rasuwa 236), 4718 lapata ki khoj jari. Uddhar update nahi.

title.zh: 新华社10月3日：中尼科考队10月4日赴尼
title.en: Xinhua 3 Oct: China-Nepal survey team leaves 4 Oct
title.ne: Xinhua 3 Oct: China-Nepal survey 4 Oct nikalchha
title.hi: Xinhua 3 Oct: China-Nepal survey 4 Oct niklegi

body.zh: 新华社成都电：中国地质大学（北京）与尼泊尔科学院组建跨境巨灾应急科考队，国内专家10月4日从成都赴尼泊尔，调查源区并服务吉隆口岸恢复。无新伤亡，无队伍坐标。
body.en: Xinhua Chengdu: a China-Nepal emergency geo survey team, led by China University of Geosciences (Beijing) with the Nepal Academy of Science, said domestic experts leave Chengdu on 4 Oct for source-area work to support Gyirong Port recovery. No new casualties and no team coordinates.
body.ne: Xinhua: China-Nepal geo survey 4 Oct Chengdu bata Nepal. Naya casualty chaina, GNSS chaina.
body.hi: Xinhua: China-Nepal geo survey 4 Oct Chengdu se Nepal. Naya casualty nahi, GNSS nahi.

title.zh: NDRRMA 10月1日：搜救结束，转入失踪核查
title.en: NDRRMA 1 Oct: SAR ended, missing verification starts
title.ne: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj sakiyo, harayeka jaanch suru
title.hi: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj khatam, lapata satyapan shuru

body.zh: epardafas引NDRRMA执行主任Upreti：10月1日记者会称博特科西—特里舒里水道搜救阶段结束，转入恢复与失踪人员核查。未公布新伤亡数字。无新队伍坐标。
body.en: epardafas cites NDRRMA chief Upreti: 1 Oct press conference said Bhotekoshi-Trishuli SAR ended and recovery plus missing-person verification began. No new casualty figures. No new team coordinates.
body.ne: epardafas/NDRRMA Upreti: 1 Oct khoj sakiyo, recovery ra harayeka jaanch suru. Naya casualty chaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: epardafas/NDRRMA Upreti: 1 Oct khoj khatam, recovery aur lapata satyapan shuru. Naya casualty nahi. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: 交通厅9月28日：G216吉隆镇—国门仍双向管制
title.en: Transport dept 28 Sep: G216 town-gate still controlled
title.ne: Transport 28 Sep: G216 dui tira niyantran
title.hi: Transport 28 Sep: G216 dono disha niyantran

body.zh: 西藏自治区交通运输厅路网：G216 K3500+200（吉隆镇）—K3525+850（吉隆国门）自8月26日起双向交通管制，解除时间待定。本轮无更新。抢险通道不等于社会通车或口岸通关。
body.en: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200 (Gyirong town) to K3525+850 (gate) remains two-way controlled since 26 Aug; lift time unset. No update this cycle. Rescue track is not public traffic or port clearance.
body.ne: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200-K3525+850 26 Aug dekhi dui tira niyantran. Yo cycle update chaina.
body.hi: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200-K3525+850 26 Aug se dono disha niyantran. Is cycle update nahi.

body.zh: PTI引NDRRMA 9月26日：1453死、5285失踪、13795获救。死亡与失踪已被警方10月4日口径替代；KPI获救仍用此数，因本轮无更新。
body.en: PTI cites NDRRMA 26 Sep: 1453 dead, 5285 missing, 13795 rescued. Dead and missing superseded by police 4 Oct; KPI rescued stays at 13795 because this cycle has no newer rescued figure.
body.ne: PTI/NDRRMA 26 Sep: uddar 13795. Mrit/harayeka police 4 Oct le badleko. Uddar naya chaina.
body.hi: PTI/NDRRMA 26 Sep: uddhar 13795. Mrit/lapata police 4 Oct se badle. Uddhar naya nahi.

title.zh: 指挥部9月6日：截至9月5日18时43死519失联
title.en: Command 6 Sep: as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing
title.ne: Command 6 Sep: 5 Sep 18:00, 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin

body.zh: 央广网引吉隆应急救援指挥部：43人遇难、519人失联、成功救出2人、遗物993件。外籍失联261人、23国。此后新华社与@XHNews未见更新伤亡。
body.en: CNR cites the Gyirong command: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued, 993 personal effects. 261 missing foreigners from 23 countries. No later casualty update from Xinhua or @XHNews.
body.ne: CNR: 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin, 2 uddar. Bideshi 261. Xinhua pachi naya casualty chaina.
body.hi: CNR: 43 mrit, 519 lapata, 2 uddhar. Videshi 261. Xinhua ke baad naya casualty nahi.

title.zh: 新华社9月5日：口岸上方堰塞湖已排空
title.en: Xinhua 5 Sep: barrier lake above the port drained
title.ne: Xinhua 5 Sep: port mathi ko bandha tal khali
title.hi: Xinhua 5 Sep: port ke upar ka barrier lake khali

body.zh: 西藏应急管理部门：堰塞湖已排空，河道恢复正常过流，危险基本解除。本轮无新堰塞湖通报。
body.en: Xizang emergency management: the lake has drained, the channel is flowing normally, and the hazard is largely eliminated. No later barrier-lake bulletin.
body.ne: Xizang emergency: tal khali, nadi sadharan. Pachi naya tal bulletin chaina.
body.hi: Xizang emergency: jheel khali, nadi normal. Baad mein naya jheel bulletin nahi.

title.zh: 美国驻尼使馆9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi-Timure
title.en: US Embassy Nepal 3 Sep: do not travel Rasuwagadhi-Timure
title.hi: US Embassy 3 Sep: Rasuwagadhi-Timure mat jao

body.zh: 使馆道路告示仍为9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi。本轮未见更新告示。
body.en: Embassy road notice remains 3 Sep: do not travel to Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi. No newer notice found.
body.ne: Embassy notice 3 Sep nai: Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi najau. Naya notice chaina.
body.hi: Embassy notice 3 Sep hi: Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi mat jao. Naya notice nahi.

detail.zh: 口岸设施已毁，通关未恢复。中方关闭。
detail.en: Port facilities destroyed; clearance not restored. Chinese side closed.
detail.ne: Port dhvasta; clearance khuleko chaina. Chiniya taraf band.
detail.hi: Port dhvast; clearance nahi. Chini taraf band.

detail.zh: 交通厅9月28日路网：K3500+200—K3525+850双向管制，解除时间待定。抢险通道仅救援。
detail.en: Transport bulletin 28 Sep: K3500+200-K3525+850 two-way control, lift time unset. Rescue track only.
detail.ne: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200-K3525+850 dui tira niyantran. Rescue bato matra.
detail.hi: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200-K3525+850 dono disha niyantran. Rescue path hi.

detail.zh: 截至9月5日18时：2500余人，核心区搜寻与消杀已覆盖。无新现场坐标。
detail.en: As of 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ personnel; core search and disinfection covered. No new live GNSS.
detail.ne: 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ jana; core khoj cover. Naya GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ log; core khoj cover. Naya GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: NDRRMA 10月1日：搜救阶段结束，转入失踪核查。警方10月4日仍部7975人处置遗体并寻找失踪者。无新队伍坐标，故不标经纬度。
detail.en: NDRRMA 1 Oct: SAR phase ended; missing-person verification underway. Police 4 Oct still list 7975 personnel on remains and missing search. No new team GNSS, so no lat/lng.
detail.ne: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj sakiyo. Police 4 Oct: 7975 jana. Toli GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj khatam. Police 4 Oct: 7975 log. Team GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: 9月5日指挥部：核心区搜寻与预防性消杀已全覆盖。
detail.en: 5 Sep command: core-area search and preventive disinfection fully covered.
detail.ne: 5 Sep command: core khoj ra disinfection cover.
detail.hi: 5 Sep command: core khoj aur disinfection cover.

detail.zh: 8月30日发布会：转移安置吉隆镇、萨勒乡5村499人。未见更新。
detail.en: 30 Aug briefing: 499 people from Gyirong town and Sale township relocated. No update.
detail.ne: 30 Aug: Gyirong town/Sale 5 gaun 499 sthanantran. Update chaina.
detail.hi: 30 Aug: Gyirong town/Sale 5 gaon 499 sthanantran. Update nahi.

status.zh: 堰塞湖已排空，河道正常过流（新华社9月5日，本轮无更新）
status.en: Barrier lake drained; channel flowing normally (Xinhua 5 Sep, no update this cycle)
status.ne: Bandha tal khali; nadi sadharan (Xinhua 5 Sep, yo cycle update chaina)
status.hi: Barrier lake khali; nadi normal (Xinhua 5 Sep, is cycle update nahi)

text.zh: 国家气候中心向尼泊尔提供滚动气候监测，支持吉隆—拉苏瓦口岸泥石流救援。无新伤亡。
text.en: National Climate Center giving Nepal rolling climate products for Gyirong-Rasuwa mudslide relief. No new casualties.
text.ne: Climate Center le Nepal lai Gyirong-Rasuwa uddar ko lagi climate anuman. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: Climate Center Nepal ko Gyirong-Rasuwa uddhar ke liye climate forecast. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: 灾后留在吉隆镇的尼泊尔工人继续工作，希望灾区尽快恢复。无新伤亡。
text.en: Nepali workers remaining in Gyirong Town continue work and hope for recovery. No new casualties.
text.ne: Gyirong Town ma Nepali karmi le kaam gare. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: Gyirong Town mein Nepali karmchari kaam jaari. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: 新华社汇总吉隆口岸泥石流与中方救援进展。未给出超过9月5日的新伤亡。
text.en: Xinhua roundup of the Gyirong Port mudslide and Chinese rescue. No casualty figure later than 5 Sep.
text.ne: Xinhua Gyirong Port saransh. 5 Sep pachi naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: Xinhua Gyirong Port roundup. 5 Sep ke baad naya casualty nahi.
